Student IT enquiries

If you have a question or need our information technology (IT) services, you can visit our Learning Hubs during staffed hours, call our helpdesk or make an online enquiry.

Find out more about student IT support.

Phone

1800 SYD UNI (1800 793 864) or +61 2 8627 1444 (outside Australia). Select option 4 for ICT.

Please listen for IT-related options including information about UniKey passwords and accessing Sydney Student, and choose the right option to access our helpdesk.

Opening hours

  • 7 am to 9 pm, Monday to Friday
  • 9 am to 5pm, Saturday

Please note these opening hours may change during the summer holiday period between December and January.

Online

If you have a question, you can make an enquiry online or email us at ict.support@sydney.edu.au

In person

  • Get support in Fisher Library, Level 3 Service Hub, 9 am to 5 pm, Monday to Friday
  • Visit us in one of our Learning Hubs during staffed hours.
